# Statement of Work — Implementation & Maintenance

> **Flavor:** Implementation **plus** ongoing maintenance/support, with structured
> SLAs, support tiers, and a warranty period.
> **Best for:** Build-then-run engagements — deploy a solution and support it live
> under defined service levels.
> **Maps to Kerdos:** one-time totals → implementation; monthly/yearly →
> maintenance; the SLA/support/warranty/security sections are **structured fields**
> on the SOW (editable in the app, rendered as real tables in the PDF). `{{…}}` merge.
